g.text: The creator's country, Ukraine, was invaded by russia in 2014. russia occupied Crimea and
parts of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions, and began to persecute the Crimean Tatars, a
people that had already been deported from its homeland in 1944. In 2022 the full-scale
The war has been going on since 2014, the full-scale invasion since 24 February 2022.
People are deported and tortured. Civilians were killed in Irpin, Bucha and many other
towns. Children are abducted, separated from their families, indoctrinated or simply killed.
